job.title: Scrum Master

About the Role

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Scrum Master to support the delivery of a portfolio of digital and technology solutions focused on energy optimisation, forecasting, operational planning and business transformation initiatives.
Working within a collaborative software delivery environment, you will help establish and embed effective Agile practices across multiple product teams.

You will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, support backlog management, remove impediments, and enable teams to deliver high-quality outcomes that create measurable value for business stakeholders.

This position plays a key role in promoting transparency, collaboration, continuous improvement and delivery excellence across a diverse technology portfolio.


Key Stakeholders

Internal
  • Technology Delivery Manager
  • Product Owners and Business Stakeholders
  • Business Analysts
  • Software Engineers and Developers
  • Data Scientists and Modelling Specialists
  • Enterprise Technology Teams
  • Operations and Planning Teams
  • Commercial and Functional Business Units
External
  • Delivery Partners
  • Technology Vendors
  • Consulting Organisations

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery & Facilitation
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-Ups, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives.
  • Establish and maintain effective Agile delivery rhythms and team practices.
  • Support teams in achieving sprint goals and maintaining a sustainable delivery pace.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through regular feedback and retrospective outcomes.
Coaching & Agile Leadership
  • Coach teams, Product Owners and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices and delivery accountability.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency and continuous learning.
  • Support Agile maturity across multiple teams and workstreams.
Backlog & Planning Support
  • Partner with Product Owners to maintain well-defined and prioritised product backlogs.
  • Support backlog refinement activities, estimation practices and sprint planning processes.
  • Encourage clear acceptance criteria and a shared understanding of delivery expectations.
Delivery Governance & Reporting
  • Identify, manage and remove delivery impediments.
  • Coordinate resolution of risks, issues and cross-team dependencies.
  • Maintain visibility of delivery progress through dashboards, metrics and reporting.
  • Facilitate release planning and support incremental delivery approaches.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Work closely with technical and business stakeholders to align priorities and delivery outcomes.
  • Promote effective communication across teams and leadership groups.
  • Provide transparency around progress, risks and improvement opportunities.
Experience Required
  • Minimum 5 years' experience as a Scrum Master within technology or digital delivery environments.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating Scrum events and Agile ceremonies.
  • Proven capability coaching cross-functional teams and Product Owners in Agile ways of working.
  • Experience establishing delivery cadences, sprint goals, backlog refinement processes and Definition of Done standards.
  • Strong track record identifying and removing impediments while managing risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Experience supporting multiple teams, products or programs simultaneously.
  • Ability to utilise delivery metrics to improve visibility, predictability and performance.
  • Experience supporting release planning and iterative software delivery.
  • Exposure to complex business and technology environments.
  • Experience within energy, resources, utilities, infrastructure or related industries will be highly regarded.
Knowledge & Technical Expertise
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile methodologies and Lean principles.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and product delivery practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence or similar Agile delivery tools.
  • Understanding of backlog management, estimation techniques and acceptance criteria development.
  • Familiarity with dependency, risk and issue management practices.
  • Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing and release management processes.
Key Skills
  • Agile facilitation and workshop leadership
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Strong communication and influencing skills
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Organisation, planning and prioritisation
  • Data-driven reporting and performance tracking
  • Collaboration across technical and business teams
Qualifications
  • Recognised Scrum Master or Agile certification such as:
    • Professional Scrum Master (PSM I or above)
    • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
    • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM)
    • Equivalent Agile certification
  • Degree qualification in Information Technology, Business, Project Management, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable.
What Success Looks Like
  • Agile practices consistently embedded across teams.
  • Sprint goals and delivery commitments regularly achieved.
  • Clear visibility of delivery progress, risks and dependencies.
  • Improved collaboration between technical and business stakeholders.
  • Continuous improvement initiatives actively driving team performance and delivery outcomes.
  • High stakeholder satisfaction and successful delivery of business value.

job.title: Senior Cost Controller
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cost Controller to provide cost management leadership across complex capital projects. This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and insightful cost control services that support project teams in making informed decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
The successful candidate will be a trusted advisor to project leadership, driving cost performance, ensuring data integrity, identifying emerging risks and opportunities, and supporting effective project governance. You will work closely with project management, planning, procurement, contracts, engineering, finance, and site teams to deliver integrated project controls solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Control & Reporting
  • Lead and manage all cost control activities for assigned projects and work packages.
  • Establish and maintain project cost baselines, budgets, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and cost coding frameworks.
  • Manage and monitor budgets, commitments, actual costs, Value of Work Done (VOWD), accruals, forecasts, cash flow, and Estimate at Completion (EAC).
  • Prepare and deliver monthly cost reports, variance analysis, trend reporting, and performance insights.
  • Provide clear recommendations and decision-support information to Project Managers and senior stakeholders.
  • Monitor project performance against approved baselines using project controls and earned value principles where appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate time-phased commitment and cash flow forecasts.
Forecasting & Change Management
  • Integrate cost forecasts with project scope, schedules, procurement activities, and contract status.
  • Assess project changes, trends, and variations, ensuring approved changes are accurately reflected in budgets and forecasts.
  • Identify potential cost risks, productivity impacts, and commercial issues, and recommend corrective actions.
Commercial & Contract Management Support
  • Review and validate contractor progress claims, invoices, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure accurate month-end accruals and cost allocation across relevant cost centres and project structures.
  • Work collaboratively with Contracts and Procurement teams to ensure financial commitments are accurately captured and managed.
Governance & Assurance
  • Maintain the integrity and quality of cost data within project controls and ERP systems.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and data quality issues.
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, project assurance activities, and governance requirements.
  • Contribute to capital planning, funding submissions, owner estimates, phase-gate reviews, and project closeout activities.
Leadership & Continuous Improvement
  • Mentor and support Cost Controllers and other project controls personnel.
  • Promote consistency, quality, and best-practice cost management standards.
  • Drive process improvements, reporting enhancements, automation initiatives, and data analytics capabilities.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.
Skills & Experience

Essential
  • Minimum 8 years' experience in Cost Control, Project Controls, or related project services roles.
  • Experience within resources, mining, energy, infrastructure, oil & gas, or major construction projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing cost control for medium to large capital projects through execution and closeout.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Budgeting and forecasting
    • Commitments management
    • VOWD and progress measurement
    • Accruals and cost reconciliation
    • Cash flow forecasting
    • Estimate at Completion (EAC)
    • Variance and trend analysis
    • Change management processes
  • Ability to integrate cost, schedule, procurement, contract, and scope information to drive project performance.
  • Experience reviewing contractor claims, invoices, and progress reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of project controls principles, WBS structures, baseline management, and earned value methodologies.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decision-making.
Desirable
  • Experience with Power BI and project cost management systems.
  • Experience with ERP and project controls platforms such as PIMS, Omega, SAP, Oracle, Pronto, or similar.
  • Previous mentoring or leadership experience within project controls teams.
  • Exposure to process automation and reporting improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
  • Tertiary qualification in:
    • Engineering
    • Commerce
    • Finance
    • Quantity Surveying
    • Construction Management
    • Project Controls
    • Or a related discipline
  • Relevant project management, cost engineering, or project controls certifications are highly regarded.
